Corporation ledger (rail slot 8, Diplomacy). Rows are grouped Friends / Hostile / Neutral by the stance tables; the presses live in a row's ACTION STRIP, which a disclosure arrow at the left of the row opens. One strip is open at a time, and a press that changes stance moves the row to its new group. Declare Hostile keeps an INLINE confirm inside the strip (demolish precedent — not literally irreversible, but not unilaterally reversible by the target either).

The Acquisitions ledger (nav rail slot 5, and the Company lens's click destination): the Buy press on a PURCHASABLE row. The two groups are the whole affordance — Purchasable rows carry the press, Possible rows show the price and carry none, because a price you cannot meet is something to save toward rather than something refused. Also still a corp_verb, so an agent issues it against the corp-command seam (ProjectIo --serve, COMMAND opcode) without going through the ledger. NOTE FOR A PLANNER: the field is LARGE — measured over twelve seeds of the shipped spawn (tools/verify/acquisition_viability.cpp section C), 88 corporations yield a mean of 81.6 buyable firms, 35.8 of them Purchasable at the moment of reading. A company is publicly_held by construction (BL-678, companies are open); only a corporation can class private or closed and be unpriceable, which is a mean of 5.2 per seed. A mean of 10.6 firms per seed price at exactly ZERO, which is not a bargain - the price floor caught a firm whose debts exceed its book value, and buy_corporation transfers that debt at face value.
